02 / Brand identity + Campaign

Vita

A sustainable clothing brand identity built around transparency, ethical production, and quality craftsmanship. The project explores how thoughtful branding and a clear labeling system can communicate Vita Terra’s commitment to renewable materials, fair production, and creating high-quality apparel that benefits both people and the planet.

View project →

03 / Graphic design + Illustration

Hum

A complete book design system for a speculative science-fiction novel set in a dystopian near future where technology has disappeared. The project includes a vintage-inspired cover illustration, dust jacket, hardcover concept, expressive typography, typesetting, and interior layouts designed to create a cohesive reading experience.
